Package dev.nandi0813.api.Event

Class FightDeathEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
dev.nandi0813.api.Event.FightDeathEvent
public class FightDeathEvent extends org.bukkit.event.Event
Fired once per confirmed death, after stats are updated and before the round/match reacts to it. Not fired for event game modes in 2.4.0. Fired on the main thread. Not cancellable.
